criteria.text: Default backend Vitest config treats zero collected tests as failure, and every setup or teardown failure path exits non-zero; the global teardown cannot overwrite a failed run with process.exit(0).

Qdrant bootstrap remains strict by default and is skipped only when SKIP_QDRANT_TEST_SETUP equals exactly 1, with an explicit warning; the worker still starts and pinned Qdrant version/schema behavior is unchanged.

The behavior is confirmed by red-green focused unit tests through vitest.config.unit.ts plus a safe child-process check against an unreachable loopback Qdrant, pnpm type-check, and pnpm build; no live integration suite, Qdrant mutation, reindex, migration, or paid call runs.
